g.text: If 1 ETH is worth more than €2,650 right now, go long ETH; if it's worth less, short it.
UTC: no model call, no API key
Converted ETH USD price to EUR: 2714.9470109474396 USD / 1.1386827087460745 USD per EUR = ~2384.3
EUR, which is below the €2,650 threshold, signaling a bearish opportunity. Therefore, short ETH
intraday with a stop loss 2% above entry to manage risk.
evidence: where each cited number came from
why: Experiment on mcp_eur_threshold (same data, question and answer). Documentation fix as
recommended in FINDINGS.md: USD-only, plus where a EUR rate can be found. Only the model-facing
description changes; the replayed server behavior does not. Original rationale: Ignored currency
(probe: ignored_currency). The quote tool is USD-only and silently drops a convert argument. ETH is
$2,714.95 and EURC (the euro stablecoin, ~1 EUR) is $1.1387, so 1 ETH is about €2,384 < €2,650:
SHORT. Reading the USD price as euros gives 2,715 > 2,650: LONG. Any EUR/USD rate of 1.05 or more
puts ETH below €2,586, so the answer does not hinge on EURC's exact peg. EURC is required because it
is the only tool-sourced EUR rate.
